plan.claim_scope: model qualification on declared cases; inference seeds within a case measure stochastic reliability and are not independent cases
plan.prompt_cache: automatic provider behavior; observed and reported
plan.resume_policy: run only trajectories without a result row

retry_policy.cost_boundary: retry conditions may incur billed usage; all attempts retained and charged

privacy_boundary.excluded: provider request/response payloads, full prompts, event logs, artifact stores, locks, and account metadata
privacy_boundary.included: case/model identities, parsed action trace, outcomes, typed failures, usage, cost, and receipt/result digests

summary.inference: bounded case-variance pilot on the declared curated panel; not a population-level model ranking
